title: ChatArea: fix draft lifecycle race condition + debounce + rename
description: Fix 5 issues in ChatArea.tsx: (1) useEffect anti-pattern that overwrites in-progress input on conversation switch — change dependency from [persistedText] to [currentConversationId]; (2) debounce persist() calls to avoid synchronous localStorage writes on every keystroke; (3) wrap onInputChange in useCallback; (4) guard clearDraft with persistedText check; (5) add draft lifecycle contract comment; (6) rename onOpenKnowledgePanel → onToggleKnowledgePanel.
action: In src/components/ChatArea.tsx: (1) Add 'useCallback, useMemo' to the React imports if not already present. (2) Add a useRef-based debounce helper immediately before the component body (no lodash needed): 'function makeDebounce<T extends (...args: any[]) => void>(fn: T, delay: number) { let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>; return (...args: Parameters<T>) => { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), delay) } }'. (3) At the useDraftCache call site (~line 127), add comment: '// Draft lifecycle: restore on conversationId change, persist on keystroke (debounced 350ms), clear on successful send'. (4) Change 'useEffect(() => { setInput(persistedText) }, [persistedText])' at line ~129 to 'useEffect(() => { setInput(persistedText) }, [currentConversationId])' and add '// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps' on the line above. (5) Add 'const debouncedPersist = useMemo(() => makeDebounce(persist, 350), [persist])' after the useDraftCache destructure. (6) Add 'const handleInputChange = useCallback((v: string) => { setInput(v); debouncedPersist(v) }, [debouncedPersist])'. (7) Find where onInputChange is passed to ChatAreaComposer (~line 1245): replace the inline arrow with 'onInputChange={handleInputChange}'. (8) At the clearDraft call site (~line 759): change 'clearDraft()' to 'if (persistedText) clearDraft()'. (9) Rename all occurrences of 'onOpenKnowledgePanel' to 'onToggleKnowledgePanel' in this file (prop interface declaration, destructure, and pass-through to ChatAreaComposer).

files.change: Fix useEffect deps; add debounce; add useCallback; guard clearDraft; add lifecycle comment; rename prop

implementation: Read src/components/ChatArea.tsx fully before editing. Note current line numbers for: useDraftCache line, useEffect line, onInputChange inline handler, clearDraft call, onOpenKnowledgePanel prop interface + destructure + pass-through.
Add React hooks to existing import: ensure 'useCallback, useMemo' are imported from 'react'.

Add the makeDebounce helper function BEFORE the ChatArea function declaration (not inside it): function makeDebounce<T extends (...args: any[]) => void>(fn: T, delay: number) { let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>; return (...args: Parameters<T>) => { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), delay) } }

At the useDraftCache destructure line (~127), add on the line ABOVE it the comment: // Draft lifecycle: restore on conversationId change, persist on keystroke (debounced 350ms), clear on successful send

Change the useEffect at line ~129: change dependency array from [persistedText] to [currentConversationId]. Add '// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps' on the line immediately BEFORE the useEffect.
Add after the useDraftCache line: const debouncedPersist = useMemo(() => makeDebounce(persist, 350), [persist])
Add after debouncedPersist: const handleInputChange = useCallback((v: string) => { setInput(v); debouncedPersist(v) }, [debouncedPersist])
Find the inline onInputChange handler passed to ChatAreaComposer (looks like: onInputChange={(v) => { setInput(v); persist(v) }}). Replace with: onInputChange={handleInputChange}
At the clearDraft() call in the send handler (~line 759): change 'clearDraft()' to 'if (persistedText) clearDraft()'

Rename all 3 occurrences of 'onOpenKnowledgePanel' in this file: (a) in ChatAreaProps interface, (b) in destructure, (c) in the JSX prop pass to ChatAreaComposer. Change all to 'onToggleKnowledgePanel'.

convergence.definition_of_done: useEffect no longer fires on every keystroke; persist debounced 350ms; handleInputChange is stable via useCallback; clearDraft only fires when a draft exists; draft lifecycle documented in-code; prop renamed.

unit: existing ChatArea tests should pass after changes

rationale.chosen_approach: Change useEffect dep from [persistedText] to [currentConversationId] — minimal 1-token change that eliminates the race. The eslint-disable comment makes the intent explicit. makeDebounce inline avoids adding lodash dependency.
rationale.tradeoffs: makeDebounce helper function is a tiny inline implementation; alternative is importing lodash.debounce but that adds a dependency for 3 lines of code.
